title: Liyasa site configuration
description: The definition of `liyasa.json` (PRD §8). This file is the single source of truth: §8's tables are generated from it, the Rust `SiteConfig` is generated from it by typify, and `liyasa schema config` emits it verbatim. Any key referenced anywhere in the PRD must exist here.

$schema.description: URL of this schema; carries the `v1` major version.

name.description: Site name. The only required key.

root.description: Content root, relative to the config file.

public.description: `false` requires an access mode under `auth` and a server; rejected with E0120 before 0.5.

source.description: A Google Fonts family, downloaded and self-hosted at build time, or a local file path.
A Google Fonts family, downloaded and self-hosted at build time, or a local file path.
A Google Fonts family, downloaded and self-hosted at build time, or a local file path.

subset.description: Accepted and ignored with W0716 until the fontations subsetter exists.

theme.description: Presets, colours, fonts, icons, appearance, layout, and overrides (§8.2).

navigation.description: The navigation tree, a file that holds it, or an object carrying tree options (§8.4).

footer.description: Footer socials, link columns, branding, and legal line (§8.5).

search.description: Search behaviour and the browser index's shard sizing (§8.6).

canonicalOrigin.description: Production origin used for absolute URLs in `llms.txt`, feeds, and the Markdown directive.

seo.description: Meta tags, JSON-LD, indexing, sitemap, robots, and crawler directives (§8.7).

strict.description: Unknown front matter keys become warnings.

lastModified.description: CFG-74: show the git or editor timestamp on every page.

locales.description: Languages this site is published in (§7.11).

dimensions.description: Custom content dimensions such as product (§7.12).

variations.description: Named content variations a page may belong to.

items.description: Hosts an absolute redirect destination may point at (E0109).

redirects.description: Redirect rules, and the hosts an absolute destination may point at (E0109).

openapi.description: OpenAPI specifications bound to this site (§13).

asyncapi.description: AsyncAPI specifications bound to this site.

graphql.description: GraphQL schemas bound to this site.

sources.description: Truth sources by id, plus the `commands` allow list (VER-25, a trust-plane key per CFG-95).

budget.description: Wall-clock budgets; W0622 queues the remainder when the deploy budget is spent.

target.description: Base URL HTTP checks run against.

telemetry.description: Liyasa's own anonymous CLI telemetry; off by default in OSS.

specVersion.description: The agent-readiness specification version this site targets (SPEC-03).

agents.description: Agent surfaces: llms.txt, Markdown output, skills, MCP (§24, §25).

items.description: Environment variables `env()` may read; their values are fingerprinted as build inputs.

build.description: Build outputs, budgets, caps, and determinism inputs (§6.6).

instructions.description: Operator text prepended to assistant and agent system prompts.

ai.description: Model routing and assistant, agent, and reindex settings.

collector.description: Static sites: URL of a collector (ANA-09).

db.description: Path or URL of the analytics database (§6.8).

items.description: CIDR. Default none: forwarded-for and region headers are ignored unless the peer is listed.

server.description: Server-mode settings that are not secrets; only meaningful to `liyasa serve`.

items.description: Remote image hosts added to `img-src` without W0719.
Hosts allowed to embed frame-mode pages.

security.description: Content Security Policy, frame ancestors, and upload rules (§30.2).

network.description: Outbound network allow lists, consumed by `liyasa-net` (§30.2.3).

authors.description: Author handles resolved from front matter `authors`.

navigationNode.description: One node of the navigation tree (§8.4). Every object form is discriminated by its own key.

oneOf.description: A page by path or route.
